# #145 — Background promoter for legacy collab to shared-kb migration

## Goal

Build an OB-side background dreamer/promoter that gradually migrates and reshapes good legacy `collab` content into canonical `shared-kb` and other correct destinations.

## Model

Separate the logical phases:

- Dreamer/classifier: scans, clusters, dedupes, scores, and proposes destinations.
- Promoter/executor: applies allowed moves with provenance, audit receipts, and policy checks.

The same service may run both phases, but promotion must be explicitly gated.

## Scope

- Scan legacy physical `collab` in resumable batches.
- Classify each item as one of:
  - shared-kb thought/decision
  - repo/project fact or entity
  - server/channel/thread lane memory
  - person/user memory such as `rico` or `kevin`
  - agent lane memory such as `bilby` or `skippy`
  - duplicate/noise/archive
  - requires manual review
- Write transformed records to the correct destination.
- Preserve provenance on every promoted/transformed record.
- Add dry-run mode, apply mode, and per-batch receipts.
- Add kill switch and low-load/backoff behavior.

## Required Provenance

Every promoted item must record:

- source physical namespace (`collab`)
- source table and id
- source lane/event ids if available
- source agent/person if known
- Discord server/guild, channel, and thread if available
- repo/project if available
- promotion actor/service
- promotion reason
- confidence/classification
- timestamp

## Operational Requirements

- Dry-run first.
- Resumable cursor.
- Idempotency keys or deterministic duplicate checks.
- Batch size limits.
- Low-load/backoff scheduling so the job chugs in the background and backs off when OB is busy.
- Audit log/report for promoted, skipped, duplicated, rejected, archived, and manual-review items.
- No secrets/credentials promotion.
- No raw transcript dumps into shared truth.

## Acceptance Criteria

- Dry-run reports candidates without writes.
- Apply mode promotes a small controlled batch with provenance.
- Re-running the same batch is idempotent.
- Promoted shared records land in physical `shared-kb`.
- Non-shared records are routed or marked for review, not blindly copied.
- Admin can pause/stop the promoter.
- Metrics/reporting show progress and remaining legacy backlog.

## Non-Goals

- No automatic unreviewed LLM truth promotion.
- No bulk rename of all `collab` rows.
- No client-side behavior changes.
- No removal of legacy fallback yet.

## Traps To Avoid

- Do not treat Dream as the authority. Dream proposes; promoter applies allowed moves.
- Do not let channel noise become shared truth.
- Do not drop provenance.
- Do not run a large mutating batch without dry-run evidence.
